question: Among all patients with total bilirubin above 1.0, find those whose anti-Cardiolipin IgM level is more than 20% above the average for this group. Return their sex, approximate age at examination, and diagnosis.

prediction.sql:
WITH GroupStats AS (
    SELECT AVG(L."XCL_025") AS AvgAclIgM
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L."XCL_037" > 1.0
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    P."XCL_059" AS sex,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS approximate_age,
    P."XCL_064" AS diagnosis
FROM Laboratory L
INNER JOIN Patient P ON L."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
CROSS JOIN GroupStats GS
WHERE L."XCL_037" > 1.0
  AND L."XCL_025" > 1.2 * GS.AvgAclIgM
